title: Rail8 package.lock, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over, D-087)
description: The exact version, content digest, repository and commit of every direct dependency package.yaml declares, sorted by name. content is sha256: and the lower-case hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 lines 'rail8-package-content 1' and 'file <path> <sha256>' for every regular file of the dependency but .git at its root, sorted by its /-separated path, each ended by a newline: the files decide, not the archive they came in. repository is the name of the dependency's git repository, one segment under the base the repositories live under; commit is the commit of that repository its files come from, 40 lower-case hex digits.
